verdict.rationale: Archive handling is a fair format-coverage question for a file-conversion tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Pandoc extracting or repacking ZIP, 7z or RAR archives as part of a conversion. The only archive-related item is the chunkedhtml output format, a zip of linked HTML files. That is an adjacent output feature, not general archive extract/repack, so it earns no credit.
